task: Lock Space Storage (FND_STORAGE) until earned by trading
open_questions: Economy designer: are earn_storage_cycles 5 and earn_storage_income 3000 (placeholders) right? 3000 is about 1.4x start cash, roughly 2 cycles of one-system net income, so it is nearly always met by cycle 5-6.
Story designer: add story id SK_EARN_LOCK with args {need}, {cycles}, {have}; the code falls back to 'Earn {need} credits from trade over {cycles} cycles ({have}/{need}).'
Income counted is gross trade income per settle (net plus upkeep, never negative), not cash. OK?
handoff: main.trade_income_total (saved as trade_income_total, old saves 0, reset on new game) adds the gross of each settle. SkillTree.can_learn returns {ok:false, reason:'earn', text} for FND_STORAGE until cycle >= earn_storage_cycles AND income >= earn_storage_income (balance.json, data_version 41). main.skill_lock_reason(id) returns the line or ''. skill_screen._status_line shows it (3-line edit) in place of the cost line for an available skill; ui-programmer may restyle. QA bots that learn FND_STORAGE via main.learn_skill now wait for the lock. Tests: new earn: checks; _learn_storage helper in run_tests.gd; suite pass=1169 fail=0.

details.playable: Space Storage cannot be learned before cycle 5 and 3000 credits of cumulative trade income; the skill node shows the progress line.
details.how_to_try: New game, open Skills, see the Space Storage node show 'Earn 3000 credits from trade over 5 cycles (x/3000)'. Trade to cycle 5 with 3000 gross income and the node becomes learnable.
